subject.title: [Bug]: mimo-v2.5 / mimo-v2.5-pro thinking content leaked into text reply causing severe repetition

question: Should this public MiMo hidden-reasoning exposure be handled through owner/security review before any new repair PR, or approved as an ordinary provider-runtime bugfix now?
rationale: A member already closed the broad unmerged fix PR and kept this issue open because the report involves hidden reasoning exposed to users, lacks live MiMo proof for the proposed repair, and needs a narrower owner-approved boundary.

options.title: Owner/security review first
options.body: Keep repair automation paused until the owner/security reviewer decides the handling path, proof requirement, and provider-owned fix boundary.

options.title: Approve narrow provider repair
options.body: Allow a new Xiaomi-owned bugfix PR that deduplicates only verified MiMo v2.5/v2.5-pro mirrored reasoning, with regression tests and redacted live MiMo proof.

options.title: Reopen an implementation attempt
options.body: A maintainer can sponsor or reopen a fix branch only after narrowing any shared SDK/core surface and supplying live proof.

recommendation.title: Owner/security review first
recommendation.body: Keep repair automation paused until the owner/security reviewer decides the handling path, proof requirement, and provider-owned fix boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They closed the related fix PR with the clearest current maintainer instruction for this issue's owner/security decision.
